capabilities: Render media slideshows from code blocks
Load all supported media from a folder
Compare two images side by side with adjustable divider
Draw annotations on images and save them
extras: Includes a roadmap showing completed and planned features; donations accepted via Buy Me a Coffee.
problem: Embedding multiple images or other media in a note stacks them vertically and takes up a lot of space.
summary: Code-block slider that groups images, gifs, videos, audio, and PDFs into one compact slideshow with captions, transitions, and annotations.
